title: Duck Chess: Conservation of Momentum Board
description: A physics-enabled chessboard where a rubber duck acts as a wrecking ball. The user launches the duck across the chess set, knocking pieces off the board while a momentum conservation tracker displays total system momentum. Players must strategically aim, adjust launch velocity, and use undo/redo to achieve target configurations.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load ABeautifulGame.glb as a chess set centered at origin and Duck.glb scaled to roughly pawn-size positioned at a launch pad beside the board. Implement a physics simulation (custom or cannon-es via CDN) with these features:

**Scene Setup:** PerspectiveCamera at (0,8,10) looking at origin. Add hemisphere light (sky 0x87CEEB, ground 0x362D1B) plus directional light with shadows. Ground plane with wood texture (procedural). Display a HUD overlay showing: total system momentum (x,y,z), kinetic energy, step counter, and undo/redo buttons.

**Core Mechanics:** Extract individual chess pieces from ABeautifulGame as separate rigid bodies on the board, each with mass proportional to piece type (pawn=1, rook=3, queen=5, king=6). The duck is a controllable projectile. Users click the duck to select it, then use: (1) arrow keys or drag to set launch direction shown by an arrow helper, (2) a slider or scroll wheel to set launch speed 1-20, (3) spacebar to launch. The duck slides/rolls across the board colliding with pieces. All collisions conserve linear momentum — display real-time momentum vector sums.

**Interaction Steps (10-14):** 1. Click duck to select, 2. Aim direction, 3. Set velocity, 4. Launch duck, 5. Observe collisions and momentum readout, 6. Click 'Reset Duck' to return duck to launch pad (pieces stay), 7. Re-aim for second shot, 8. Adjust power, 9. Launch again, 10. Use Undo button to revert last launch (all pieces return to pre-launch positions), 11. Modify aim, 12. Re-launch, 13. Use Redo to restore undone state, 14. Verify momentum conservation in HUD.

**Undo/Redo System:** Before each launch, snapshot all piece positions/velocities. Maintain a state stack supporting at least 5 levels of undo/redo. Buttons in HUD and Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y hotkeys.

**Conservation Law Display:** Show a colored bar graph overlay: green when total momentum is conserved within 1% tolerance across collisions, red if violated. Track and display energy lost to friction separately.
